text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I got plenty of rest~! Repainted my nails, went shopping...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Man, that was super fun! Honestly, can today just be a day off too?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, it's time for training, right?
Yeah, yeah, you don't even have to tell me."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having spent a fulfilling day off,
Tosen Jordan seems to have fully recharged!
